cli.help.en:
vibepier: Mac controls, phone connections and Ulanzi Vibe Key (AU05) driver

Device information
  vibepier info [--json]                 Show dongle, mic, battery and settings
  vibepier monitor                       Print key presses, battery and link events
  vibepier battery                       Show the mic battery

Settings
  vibepier settings [--json]             Show all device settings
  vibepier set sleep <off|1h|2h|3h|4h|seconds>
  vibepier set vibration <on|off|0-255>
  vibepier set denoise <on|off>
  vibepier set light-mode <off|on|work>
  vibepier set brightness <0-20>
  vibepier set led <0-3> <type|time|breathe-level|breathe-brightness|brightness> <value>
  vibepier set hooks-mode <on|off>
  vibepier set standby-time <seconds>
  vibepier set audio-button-mode <n>
  vibepier set mic <on|off>

Buttons (stored in the Vibe Key firmware; they work without vibepier running)
  vibepier buttons [--json]              Show what each control sends
  vibepier bind <control> <binding>      Controls: talk, confirm, cancel, knob-press,
                                      knob-left, knob-right
                                      Bindings: a hotkey such as "cmd+shift+4",
                                      "fixed:<media key>", or "factory"
  vibepier reset-buttons                 Restore the factory functions
  vibepier keys                          List key names and media keys

Configuration and daemon
  vibepier config init|show|path         Manage ~/Library/Application Support/vibepier/config.json
  vibepier preferences export <file>     Export portable settings without credentials
  vibepier preferences import <file> [--dry-run]
                                      Validate/merge settings into the running Mac app
  vibepier apply                         Push the configuration file to the device
  vibepier daemon [--verbose]            Run in the foreground
  vibepier service install|uninstall|status
                                      Run the daemon at login with launchd
  vibepier status                        Ask the running daemon for its state
  vibepier reload                        Tell the daemon to reload its configuration
  vibepier relay status|disable          Show or disable the configured cloud relay
  vibepier relay configure --url <wss-url> --room <room> --secret-file <path>
                                      [--dns-recovery system|alidns]
                                      Save credentials in the running Mac app's Keychain
  vibepier android-update <apk>          Register the available Android update
  vibepier phone-install --list           List authorized APK recipients
  vibepier phone-install <apk> [device]    Send an APK without ADB
  vibepier phone-install --status [device]
  vibepier phone-install --cancel [device]

AI agent hooks (LED status from Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Copilot CLI)
  vibepier hooks install [--agent <id>] [--config <file>] [--dry-run]
  vibepier hooks uninstall [--agent <id>] [--config <file>] [--dry-run]
  vibepier hooks status
  vibepier hook --agent <id> --event <name>   Called by the agent (reads JSON on stdin)

Maintenance
  vibepier reboot <device|dongle>
  vibepier firmware check                Ask Ulanzi's update server (sends the dongle serial)
  vibepier firmware update --target <device|dongle> --file <image> --yes
  vibepier raw <hex bytes> [--wait <ms>] Send one AU05 USB frame and print replies
  vibepier test leds|vibration           Cycle LED work types or try the motor, then restore

Global options
  --verbose                           Log every frame
  --pid <hex>                         Use another product ID (default 00DD)
  session-provider-set <codex|claude|zcode> <on|off>

  Usage: vibepier agents status | codex enable --executable /absolute/codex --workspace /absolute/project | codex disable | claude-mods enable --reviewed-version VERSION | claude-mods disable | claude-mods bind --session ID --workspace /absolute/project --runtime-version VERSION --contract-digest SHA256

  vibepier set audio-button-mode <n>

                                      knob-left, knob-right
                                      绑定：快捷键（如 "cmd+shift+4"）、
                                      "fixed:<media key>" 或 "factory"
  vibepier reset-buttons                 恢复出厂按键功能
  vibepier keys                          列出普通按键与媒体键名称

配置与后台服务
  vibepier config init|show|path         管理 ~/Library/Application Support/vibepier/config.json
  vibepier preferences export <file>     导出可迁移设置，不包含凭据
  vibepier preferences import <file> [--dry-run]
                                      校验设置并合并到正在运行的 Mac 应用
  vibepier apply                         将配置文件应用到设备
  vibepier daemon [--verbose]            以前台进程运行
  vibepier service install|uninstall|status
                                      通过 launchd 在登录时运行后台服务
  vibepier status                        查询正在运行的后台服务状态
  vibepier reload                        通知后台服务重新加载配置
  vibepier relay status|disable          查看或关闭已配置的云中继
  vibepier relay configure --url <wss-url> --room <room> --secret-file <path>
                                      [--dns-recovery system|alidns]
                                      将凭据保存在正在运行的 Mac 应用钥匙串中
  vibepier android-update <apk>          登记可用的 Android 更新
  vibepier phone-install --list           列出已授权的 APK 接收设备
  vibepier phone-install <apk> [device]    无需 ADB 即可发送 APK
  vibepier phone-install --status [device]
  vibepier phone-install --cancel [device]

AI 代理钩子（显示 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI、Cursor、Copilot CLI 的 LED 状态）
  vibepier hooks install [--agent <id>] [--config <file>] [--dry-run]
  vibepier hooks uninstall [--agent <id>] [--config <file>] [--dry-run]
  vibepier hooks status
  vibepier hook --agent <id> --event <name>   由代理调用（从标准输入读取 JSON）

维护
  vibepier reboot <device|dongle>
  vibepier firmware check                查询 Ulanzi 更新服务器（会发送接收器序列号）
  vibepier firmware update --target <device|dongle> --file <image> --yes
  vibepier raw <hex bytes> [--wait <ms>] 发送一帧 AU05 USB 数据并输出回复
  vibepier test leds|vibration           循环测试 LED 模式或振动马达，然后恢复

全局选项
  --verbose                           记录每帧数据
  --pid <hex>                         使用其他产品 ID（默认 00DD）
  session-provider-set <codex|claude|zcode> <on|off>

  用法：vibepier agents status | codex enable --executable /absolute/codex --workspace /absolute/project | codex disable | claude-mods enable --reviewed-version VERSION | claude-mods disable | claude-mods bind --session ID --workspace /absolute/project --runtime-version VERSION --contract-digest SHA256

provider.claude_stop_unconfirmed.en: The stop action was sent, but the original Claude turn has not been confirmed as stopped. Check on the Mac.
provider.claude_stop_unconfirmed.zh-Hans: 已发送停止操作，但尚未确认原 Claude 回合结束，请在 Mac 上核对。

provider.claude_send_receipt_missing.en: The native Claude message receipt is unavailable. Check on the Mac before sending again.
provider.claude_send_receipt_missing.zh-Hans: 无法确认 Claude 原生消息回执，再次发送前请在 Mac 上核对。

session.codex_creation_busy.en: Another Codex session is being created. Wait for its result before starting another.
session.codex_creation_busy.zh-Hans: 另一个 Codex 会话正在创建，请等待结果后再新建。

session.codex_creation_project_unverifie.en: Cannot uniquely verify this Codex project and its working directory. Use a saved local project with one root and a unique name.
session.codex_creation_project_unverifie.zh-Hans: 无法唯一确认 Codex 项目及工作目录。请使用已保存、名称唯一且只有一个根目录的本地项目。

session.codex_creation_composer_unverifi.en: The Codex composer or selected project changed. Nothing will be submitted again automatically.
session.codex_creation_composer_unverifi.zh-Hans: Codex 输入框或所选项目已变化，不会自动再次提交。

session.codex_creation_unconfirmed.en: Could not confirm a new Codex session with the original message. Check its composer and session list on the Mac; do not send it again.
session.codex_creation_unconfirmed.zh-Hans: 尚未确认包含原始消息的新 Codex 会话。请在 Mac 检查输入框和会话列表，不要重复发送。

session.codex_creation_build_unverified.en: Creating sessions is not verified for this Codex desktop build. Create the session on the Mac first.
session.codex_creation_build_unverified.zh-Hans: 尚未验证此 Codex 桌面构建的新建流程。请先在 Mac 上创建会话。

control.requests_busy.en: The Mac is still handling earlier requests. Wait for their results, then try again.
control.requests_busy.zh-Hans: Mac 仍在处理此前请求，请等待结果后重试。

control.receipt_result_save_failed.en: The action result could not be saved. Its status remains unconfirmed; check the Mac before sending again.
control.receipt_result_save_failed.zh-Hans: 无法保存操作结果，当前仍按未确认处理。再次发送前请先在 Mac 核对。

provider.desktop_input_changed.en: The desktop control or input focus changed. Check the Mac before trying again.
provider.desktop_input_changed.zh-Hans: 桌面控件或输入焦点已变化，请先在 Mac 上确认后再操作。

provider.desktop_clipboard_unavailable.en: The clipboard changed or could not be safely preserved. Copy a small text item and try again.
provider.desktop_clipboard_unavailable.zh-Hans: 剪贴板已变化或无法完整保留，请复制一小段文本后重试。

provider.zcode_receipt_baseline_unavaila.en: The native ZCode session baseline is incomplete or exceeds the supported limit. Create the task on the Mac.
provider.zcode_receipt_baseline_unavaila.zh-Hans: ZCode 原生会话基线不完整或超出支持上限，请在 Mac 上新建任务。

provider.receipt_capacity.en: The provider receipt cache is full. Resolve outstanding operations on the Mac before trying again.
provider.receipt_capacity.zh-Hans: 服务商操作回执缓存已满，请先在 Mac 上确认未完成的操作后再试。

provider.claude_output_limit.en: Claude output exceeded the supported limit. Check the original session on the Mac; the operation was not resent.
provider.claude_output_limit.zh-Hans: Claude 输出超出支持上限，请在 Mac 上检查原会话；操作未重新发送。

provider.claude_output_unconfirmed.en: Claude exited without a complete, verifiable output result. Check the original session on the Mac.
provider.claude_output_unconfirmed.zh-Hans: Claude 退出时未取得完整、可核验的输出结果，请在 Mac 上检查原会话。

usage.codex_missing.en: Install or open Codex on the Mac to view account usage.
usage.codex_missing.zh-Hans: 请先在 Mac 上安装或打开 Codex，再查看账户用量。

usage.unavailable.en: Codex account usage is unavailable. Check the signed-in account on the Mac, then refresh.
usage.unavailable.zh-Hans: 暂时无法读取 Codex 账户用量，请在 Mac 上确认已登录后刷新。

usage.timeout.en: Codex did not reply in time. Refresh usage; do not submit another reset while its result is unknown.
usage.timeout.zh-Hans: Codex 回复超时。可刷新用量；重置结果未知时请勿再次兑换。

usage.account_changed.en: The Codex account changed or confirmation is missing. Refresh and confirm the selected card again.
usage.account_changed.zh-Hans: Codex 账户已变化或缺少确认，请刷新后重新确认所选卡片。

usage.not_eligible.en: A five-hour or weekly Codex window must have 10% or less remaining before using a reset.
usage.not_eligible.zh-Hans: Codex 五小时或每周额度剩余不超过 10% 时才可使用重置卡。

usage.no_credit.en: No gifted reset cards are currently available.
usage.no_credit.zh-Hans: 目前没有可用的赠送重置卡。

usage.card_changed.en: This reset card is no longer available. Refresh the card list.
usage.card_changed.zh-Hans: 这张重置卡已不可用，请刷新卡片列表。

session.image_preview_unavailable.en: Image preview is unavailable. You can continue reading the conversation; retry the image later.
session.image_preview_unavailable.zh-Hans: 图片预览暂不可用，可以继续查看会话，稍后再试这张图片。

control.application_selection_invalid.en: Choose an installed Mac application and a valid shortcut slot.
control.application_selection_invalid.zh-Hans: 请选择 Mac 已安装的应用和有效的快捷栏位置。

control.application_selection_changed.en: The application shortcuts changed. Refresh the list and choose again.
control.application_selection_changed.zh-Hans: 应用快捷栏已发生变化，请刷新列表后重新选择。

control.application_selection_unavailabl.en: The Mac application list is unavailable. Refresh to check whether your selection was saved.
control.application_selection_unavailabl.zh-Hans: 暂时无法读取 Mac 应用，请刷新以确认所选配置是否已保存。

provider.claude_process_capacity.en: Claude background runs are at capacity (4 per phone, 8 total). Wait for a running turn to finish; nothing new was started.
provider.claude_process_capacity.zh-Hans: Claude 后台任务已达上限（每台手机 4 个、共 8 个）。请等待现有任务完成；本次没有启动新任务。

session.file_access_unavailable.en: File access is taking too long. Check the folder permission prompt on the Mac, then retry. Other session actions remain available.
session.file_access_unavailable.zh-Hans: 文件访问超时，请在 Mac 检查文件夹访问权限提示后重试。其他会话操作仍可使用。

session.codex_creation_settings_unverifi.en: The new native Codex session does not match the requested model or approval settings. No first message was sent.
session.codex_creation_settings_unverifi.zh-Hans: 新 Codex 会话的模型或审批设置与所选配置不一致，首条消息尚未发送。

session.provider_queue_busy.en: This app is taking too long to handle earlier requests. This request was not started. Try another session app or retry after it recovers.
session.provider_queue_busy.zh-Hans: 当前应用处理此前请求过慢，本次请求尚未执行。可以切换其他应用的会话，或等它恢复后重试。

session.desktop_busy.en: Another desktop action is still running. This action was not started; try again after it finishes.
session.desktop_busy.zh-Hans: 另一个桌面操作仍在执行，本次操作尚未开始，请稍后重试。

files.the_file_does_not_exist_or_cannot_.en: The file does not exist or cannot be read
files.the_file_does_not_exist_or_cannot_.zh-Hans: 文件不存在或不可读取

files.only_regular_files_can_be_opened_u.en: Only regular files can be opened; use Show in Finder instead
files.only_regular_files_can_be_opened_u.zh-Hans: 只能打开普通文件，可改为在访达中显示

files.this_file_is_executable_use_show_i.en: This file is executable; use Show in Finder
files.this_file_is_executable_use_show_i.zh-Hans: 这是可执行文件，为安全起见只能在访达中显示

files.opening_this_file_type_could_run_c.en: Opening this file type could run code; use Show in Finder
files.opening_this_file_type_could_run_c.zh-Hans: 此类文件打开时可能运行程序，为安全起见只能在访达中显示

files.no_application_on_the_mac_can_open.en: No application on the Mac can open this file
files.no_application_on_the_mac_can_open.zh-Hans: Mac 上没有能打开此文件的应用

files.the_default_application_may_execut.en: The default application may execute this file; use Show in Finder
files.the_default_application_may_execut.zh-Hans: 此文件默认由会运行它的应用打开，为安全起见只能在访达中显示

files.git_is_not_available_on_the_mac.en: Git is not available on the Mac
files.git_is_not_available_on_the_mac.zh-Hans: Mac 上没有可用的 git

provider.claude_rate_limited.en: Claude returned an account rate limit (HTTP 429). The session was created, but this reply was delayed. Check the provider limit and the native session before retrying; creating another session will not remove the limit.
provider.claude_rate_limited.zh-Hans: Claude 返回账户速率限制（HTTP 429）。会话已创建，但本轮回复受阻。请检查服务商限额和原生会话状态后再决定是否重试；重复新建不会解除限流。

provider.claude_api_unavailable.en: Claude recorded an API request error during this turn. Check the native session and provider status before retrying.
provider.claude_api_unavailable.zh-Hans: Claude 在本轮记录了 API 请求错误。请检查原生会话和服务商状态后再决定是否重试。

updates.invalid_metadata.en: Invalid APK version metadata or digest. Keep the APK and its .apk.json file together.
updates.invalid_metadata.zh-Hans: APK 版本信息或摘要无效，请将 APK 和对应的 .apk.json 文件放在一起。

updates.increment_version.en: Increase the Android version code before registering a changed APK. Downgrades are refused.
updates.increment_version.zh-Hans: APK 内容变化后须先递增 Android 构建号；不能登记更低版本。

updates.no_release.en: No Android update is registered on this Mac.
updates.no_release.zh-Hans: 此 Mac 尚未登记 Android 更新。

updates.preparation_busy.en: APK preparation is busy. Try again after the current preparation finishes.
updates.preparation_busy.zh-Hans: 正在准备 APK，请等待当前准备完成后再试。

updates.active_transfer.en: This phone already has an active installation task. Finish or cancel it before sending another APK.
updates.active_transfer.zh-Hans: 这台手机已有进行中的安装任务，请先完成或取消，再发送其他 APK。

updates.no_newer_release.en: The registered release is not newer than the version on this phone.
updates.no_newer_release.zh-Hans: 已登记版本不高于这台手机当前版本。

updates.registration_hint.en: Registration makes this release available to authorized phones. Sending an APK is a separate step.
updates.registration_hint.zh-Hans: 登记后，已授权手机可获取此版本；发送 APK 需单独操作。

updates.phone_offline.en: Phone is offline. The task waits until VibePier reconnects.
updates.phone_offline.zh-Hans: 手机离线，任务将等待 VibePier 重新连接。

updates.finish_on_phone.en: Complete the permission or installation prompt on the receiving phone.
updates.finish_on_phone.zh-Hans: 请在接收手机上完成权限或系统安装确认。

provider.claude_history_unavailable.en: This history could not be read safely. Reopen the session.
provider.claude_history_unavailable.zh-Hans: 暂时无法安全读取这段历史，请重新打开会话。

provider.claude_history_page_too_large.en: This turn is too large to load safely on the phone. Its complete history is preserved on the Mac.
provider.claude_history_page_too_large.zh-Hans: 这一轮内容过大，暂时无法在手机安全加载；完整历史仍保留在 Mac。

provider.claude_history_busy.en: Too many Claude histories are open. Close another session and try again.
provider.claude_history_busy.zh-Hans: 同时打开的 Claude 历史过多，请关闭其他会话后重试。

mac.key_name_required.en: Enter a key name (up to 200 characters).
mac.key_name_required.zh-Hans: 请输入按键名称（最多 200 个字符）。

files.video_workspace_only.en: Only MP4 files inside this session workspace can be played.
files.video_workspace_only.zh-Hans: 仅支持播放此会话项目目录内的 MP4 文件。

files.video_size_limit.en: Video preview supports non-empty MP4 files up to 128 MB.
files.video_size_limit.zh-Hans: 视频预览支持非空且不超过 128 MB 的 MP4 文件。

mac.disk_access_reason.en: VibePier reads project files, attachments and images. macOS manages access to Downloads, Documents, Desktop and other protected folders. Full Disk Access is the default setup step after installation.
mac.disk_access_reason.zh-Hans: VibePier 需要读取项目文件、附件和图片。下载、文稿、桌面及其他受限目录的访问权限由 macOS 管理，安装后默认引导开启完全磁盘访问。

mac.disk_access_steps.en:
1. Open Full Disk Access in System Settings.
2. Click +, select the current VibePier in Applications and enable its switch.
3. If access still fails after reinstalling, remove the old VibePier entry and add the current installed copy again.
4. Quit and reopen VibePier after authorization, then retry the operation.
mac.disk_access_steps.zh-Hans:
1. 打开系统设置中的「完全磁盘访问」。
2. 点击 +，选择「应用程序」中当前安装的 VibePier，并开启开关。
3. 重装后若开关已开启仍无法访问，请移除旧 VibePier 项，重新添加当前安装副本。
4. 授权后退出并重新打开 VibePier，再重试当前操作。

mac.disk_access_system_status.en: Authorization is managed by macOS. Confirm the VibePier switch in System Settings; opening this page does not grant access.
mac.disk_access_system_status.zh-Hans: 授权状态由 macOS 管理。请在系统设置中确认 VibePier 开关；打开本页面不代表已授权。

mac.open_disk_settings.zh-Hans: 打开完全磁盘访问设置

mac.reveal_installed_app.zh-Hans: 在 Finder 中显示 VibePier

mac.accessibility_setup.zh-Hans: 桌面控制的辅助功能权限

mac.accessibility_setup_detail.en: Enable Accessibility separately to use remote keys and desktop actions. Microphone permission is requested when voice features are used.
mac.accessibility_setup_detail.zh-Hans: 遥控按键和桌面操作仍需单独开启辅助功能权限。麦克风权限在使用语音功能时请求。

mac.permissions_settings_failed.en: Could not open System Settings. Open Privacy & Security manually.
mac.permissions_settings_failed.zh-Hans: 无法打开系统设置，请手动进入「隐私与安全性」。

providers.help.en: Only enabled assistants appear on the phone. Turning one off does not stop its desktop tasks.
providers.help.zh-Hans: 只有启用的助手会在手机上显示。关闭不会停止桌面端任务。

providers.disabled_on_mac.en: This assistant is disabled on the Mac. Enable it in the Mac menu to continue.
providers.disabled_on_mac.zh-Hans: 此助手已在 Mac 上关闭，请在 Mac 菜单中启用后继续。

mac.file_access_denied.en: macOS refused file access. Review VibePier in Files and Folders or Full Disk Access; after reinstalling, you may need to add the current app again.
mac.file_access_denied.zh-Hans: macOS 已拒绝文件访问。请检查 VibePier 的「文件与文件夹」或「完全磁盘访问」设置；重装后可能需要重新添加当前应用。

mac.file_access_review.zh-Hans: 检查 Mac 文件访问权限

mac.open_folder_settings.zh-Hans: 打开文件与文件夹设置

mac.file_access_unknown.zh-Hans: 尚未验证 · 点击检查

mac.file_access_confirmed.zh-Hans: 已可访问 · 再次检查

mac.file_access_required.zh-Hans: 需要授权 · 再次检查

mac.file_access_unknown_detail.en: This checks only the most recent file VibePier attempted to read. First open a project image or file on the phone, then click Check. Without a recent file, access remains unverified.
mac.file_access_unknown_detail.zh-Hans: 这里只检查 VibePier 最近尝试读取的文件。请先在手机打开项目图片或文件，再点击检查；没有近期文件时会保持尚未验证。

mac.file_access_check_detail.en: Rechecking the most recent file in the background. No other folders are scanned.
mac.file_access_check_detail.zh-Hans: 正在后台重新读取最近的文件，不会扫描其他目录。

mac.file_access_confirmed_detail.en: The most recent file read succeeded. This does not verify access to every folder or the Full Disk Access switch. Click to recheck that file.
mac.file_access_confirmed_detail.zh-Hans: 最近的文件读取已成功。这不代表所有目录均可访问，也不代表已验证「完全磁盘访问」系统开关；点击可再次检查该文件。

mac.file_access_required_detail.en: The actual file read was refused. Check System Settings, add the current VibePier again if needed, and quit and reopen the app after authorization.
mac.file_access_required_detail.zh-Hans: 实际文件读取被系统拒绝。请检查系统设置，必要时重新添加当前 VibePier，并在授权后退出重启应用。

mac.file_access_check_timeout.en: The check has not finished, so access is unverified. Wait for this check to finish; after changing authorization, quit and reopen VibePier before trying again.
mac.file_access_check_timeout.zh-Hans: 检查暂未完成，访问状态仍未验证。请等待本次检查结束；修改授权后退出并重新打开 VibePier，再重试。

agent.upgrade_required.en: Update the phone and Mac, then reopen the session.
agent.upgrade_required.zh-Hans: 请同步更新手机与 Mac，并刷新会话后再操作。

agent.capability_unavailable.en: The action is unavailable or the session state could not be verified.
agent.capability_unavailable.zh-Hans: 此操作暂不可用，或尚未能核验会话状态。

agent.runtime_unavailable.en: The optional agent runtime is unavailable. Check its local configuration.
agent.runtime_unavailable.zh-Hans: 可选 Agent 运行时不可用，请检查本机配置。

core.unlock_preferences_read_failed.zh-Hans: 无法读取 Mac 解锁偏好，请在 Mac 检查本地偏好文件。

core.unlock_preferences_save_failed.en: Could not save Mac unlock preferences. The previous password was preserved.
core.unlock_preferences_save_failed.zh-Hans: 无法保存 Mac 解锁偏好，原密码已保留。

core.unlock_preferences_invalid_failed.en: Mac unlock preferences are invalid for the current user.
core.unlock_preferences_invalid_failed.zh-Hans: Mac 解锁偏好无效或不属于当前用户。

core.unlock_preferences_migration_failed.en: Could not migrate the previous unlock password ({0}). Save it once in Mac unlock setup.

provider.zcode_insufficient_balance.en: ZCode received the message, but the model provider reported insufficient balance or no available resource package (1113). Check your ZCode account quota or select a model with available quota. No message was resent.
provider.zcode_insufficient_balance.zh-Hans: ZCode 已收到消息，但模型服务商返回余额不足或无可用资源包（1113）。请检查 ZCode 账户额度，或选择有额度的模型；没有自动重发消息。

provider.zcode_reply_failed.en: ZCode received the message, but the model reply failed. Check the error in the original ZCode session on the Mac. No message was resent.
provider.zcode_reply_failed.zh-Hans: ZCode 已收到消息，但模型回复失败。请在 Mac 的原 ZCode 会话查看具体错误；没有自动重发消息。
